name: nick-extensions
description: Owner-controlled Manifest V3 extensions: Ad & Tracker Blocker, InkShade dark mode, and JW.org Study Tools

scripts.build: bun scripts/build-shared.mjs && bun scripts/build-extension.mjs clearshield && bun run build:inkshade && bun scripts/build-extension.mjs studynav
scripts.package:dist: bun run build && zip -qrFS dist-smoke.zip packages/clearshield/dist packages/inkshade/dist packages/studynav/dist -x '*/_metadata/*'
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run test:inkshade-upstream && bun run build && bun run smoke-check && bun run smoke:browser && bun run smoke-check
